name: a-pdlc-kit
description: A-PDLC Kit — a documentation discipline for code repositories: four levels (AGENTS.md, PRODUCT.md, ADRs, specs), the skills that keep it alive, and the skill that builds against them test-first

plugins.name: a-pdlc-kit
plugins.description: Installs and maintains a four-level documentation discipline on a repository, records a feature's decisions while they still exist, records the decisions that arrive without code, and builds a spec into code and tests once it has a go-ahead
